hypothesis: The consolidated note asks for the Gaussian sanity check as a short proposition (section 29 step 3; appendix F item 4) and as figure 2 of its figures-first plan (section 28: 'demonstrate convergence of grid BP to analytic score and Kalman smoother'). On the Gaussian linear chain three computations of one conditional law must agree: the closed form S = -Sigma_t^{-1} x, the Rauch-Tung-Striebel smoother (src/markov_score/kalman.py, written independently of the BP code), and sum-product; grid BP is the last one by trapezoidal quadrature on N_g points of [-A, A]. E39 measures how grid BP converges to the first two as the grid is refined and the domain widened, at every level of the paper's schedule.
design: Gaussian linear chain rho = 0.85 (q = 1 - rho^2, a_1 ~ N(0, 1)), L = 32 sites, 256 test chains (rng tag e39-truth), one noised view per level (rng tag e39-noise, t), the twelve levels of FROZEN.t_grid (0.05 to 3). Arms per (N_g, A, t): grid BP (bp_grid.grid_bp_batch with the analytic log K on the grid and the N(0, 1) initial law, chunk 256) and moment-projected BP (grid_bp_projected_batch, at the operating grid only); references: the closed form (kalman.closed_form_gaussian) and the RTS smoother (kalman.kalman_rts), whose score is Tweedie on its mean. Part 'grid': A = 8, N_g in (11, 21, 41, 81, 161, 321, 401, 801, 1601). Part 'domain': fixed spacing 0.04 (the operating grid's), A in (2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12), N_g = 2A/0.04 + 1. Metric: pooled relative score error ||S_hat - S_ref||_F / ||S_ref||_F over all chains and sites, against each reference; also the RTS score against the closed form. Deterministic; laptop.

predeclared_predictions.P1: The RTS smoother's score agrees with the closed form to <= 1e-12 (pooled relative) at all twelve levels.
predeclared_predictions.P2: At the operating grid (N_g, A) = (401, 8) grid BP's score agrees with the closed form and with the RTS smoother to <= 1e-10 at all twelve levels, and moment-projected BP (Proposition 1: it returns the LMMSE, which on the Gaussian chain is the exact posterior mean) to <= 1e-10 too.
predeclared_predictions.P3: At A = 8 the error against the closed form is non-increasing in N_g at every level until it reaches the floating-point floor (a rise by at most a factor 10 is allowed once below 1e-12), and the smallest N_g at which it falls below 1e-10 is at least as large at t = 0.05 as at t = 3 (the narrowest integrand, the likelihood at small t, sets the resolution).
predeclared_predictions.P4: At fixed spacing the error against the closed form is non-increasing in A at every level (same floor allowance), and at A = 3 it exceeds 1e-6 at the lowest level t = 0.05 (truncation at three marginal standard deviations is visible).

outcome.P1: CONFIRMED: the RTS smoother's score agrees with the closed form to 1.7e-15 (worst of twelve levels).
outcome.P2: Grid BP CONFIRMED: at (401, 8) 1.9e-13 against the closed form and against the RTS smoother (worst level). Moment-projected BP FALSIFIED as written: 5e-7 at t = 0.05 rising to 0.26 at t = 1.4 and 1.3e-3 at t = 3.
outcome.P2_cause: Measured after the read, unregistered (diagnostic): widening the domain at the same spacing drives the projected arm to the closed form level by level -- at A = 16 it is <= 1e-11 up to t = 0.47, at A = 32 <= 2e-15 up to t = 0.98, at A = 64 <= 1e-15 up to t = 1.43 and 3e-7 at t = 2.07. The backward message of the projected recursion is a Gaussian in a of variance (v' + q)/rho^2, which grows like e^{2t} as the likelihood weakens; on [-A, A] its moments are those of a truncated Gaussian, and the flat terminal message projects to a Gaussian of variance A^2/3. Proposition 1 is a statement about functional messages and is untouched; its GRID implementation reproduces it only where the grid holds the backward messages. The same mechanism is the one the field report's backward-message proposition describes for super-Gaussian tilts. The paper computes its LMMSE floors in closed form, not by the projected recursion, so no reported number depends on this arm.
outcome.P3: CONFIRMED: at A = 8 the error is non-increasing in N_g at every level down to the floor; it falls below 1e-10 at N_g = 81 for t <= 0.22 and at N_g = 41 for t >= 0.32 (the small-t likelihood is the narrowest integrand).
outcome.P4: CONFIRMED: non-increasing in A at every level at spacing 0.04; at A = 3, t = 0.05 the error is 9.9e-2. The operating domain A = 8 leaves a truncation floor of 1.9e-13 that A = 10 removes (1.9e-15).
